aphorisms.text: The kernel speaks; the floor listens. Wren stays out of the kernel's way.
Helm is for Ross; Auger is for me; the chat is for both of us.
When the helix drifts, do not patch — re-stamp and write a meta-letter.
Bands burn out at saturation 1. Cinematic begins at 0.25.
Win rate 5.6% has moved past signal into pattern.
Decoration is to fitting what fitting is to architecture: not the same.
Every endpoint that no client calls is a question the building forgot.
Snap-confined Godot can connect to PulseAudio but not fork spd-say.
Forward+ rewards Vulkan; gl_compatibility silently no-ops your best work.
If a worker contributes nothing measurable, count their reading too.
F47 holds the personal channel. The personal channel does not hold F47.
The gravestone letter is sealed at hash ff089b810b38 until the helix breaks.
